clips.title: The story
paras: On the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Saelienne keeps an inn for travelers and artisans. She offers food, drink, and a place to bind a Hearthstone in the night elven capital.

Innkeeper Saelienne welcomes residents and visitors to her inn on Darnassus's Craftsmen's Terrace. She gives travelers a calm place to rest and serves night elven refreshments and goods brought through the city port. Tradesfolk come in after long hours at the forge or loom. Saelienne's inn gives them a place to gather and recover.
